task.title: Preview deploys for pull requests
task.description:
## Why
Reviewers can try a change at a real address before it merges.

## Steps
1. Add a workflow step that uploads a preview version of the site for each pull request and comments its address on the pull request.
2. Skip the step for pull requests from forks, which have no access to secrets.

## Done when
- A pull request from a branch in the repo gets a comment with a working preview address.
- A pull request from a fork passes checks without a preview.
